feeds.title: Cycling UK | The Cyclists' Champion
feeds.description: Cycling UK, the national cycling charity inspires and helps people to cycle and keep cycling. We encourage all types of cycling, on the road or off it. We support you if you already ride, or would like to ride, to work or school, for health, touring, sport and leisure or just because it's fun.

feeds.title: Merlin Cycles Blog
feeds.description: Blog posts and News on Buyers Guides, Merlin Riders, New Riders, Reviews and more. Entertaining and useful stuff from the world of Merlin Cycles.

feeds.title: Road And Mountain Bike Reviews
feeds.description: Provides reviews on popular road and mountain bikes. Know the best road bikes of the year and common questions answers, accessories and more...

feeds.title: Skedaddle Blog
feeds.description: Articles on cycling type, travel inspiration, tips & tricks on cycling. Featuring everything from destination highlights to top picks from the team. We're passionate about pedallin and there is no better way to soak up a country, its culture, see its wildlife and its people, than by bike!

feeds.title: ProCyclingUK.com
feeds.description: Articles about pro cycling and the exploits I get up to doing cycling sportives, time trials and events in the UK and abroad.

feeds.title: Epic Road Rides
feeds.description: Epic Road Rides is the travel guide for road cyclists. We give you everything you need to plan unforgettable bike rides and cycling trips worldwide. You'll find candid tips on cycling accommodation and bike hire plus the best routes, GPX & more.

feeds.title: Epic Road Rides
feeds.description: Epic Road Rides is the go-to website for road cyclists that love to travel. You'll find travel inspiration and information to help cyclists plan trips worldwide, with first-hand accounts of rides in 50+ cycling destinations around the world and all the practical information cyclists needed, from route guides and GPX downloads to tips on where to stay and when to go.

feeds.title: Where My Wheels Go
feeds.description: Get the latest updates from the Where My Wheels Go Blog. Where My Wheels Go is all about beautiful traffic-free cycling routes for those who enjoy the view.

feeds.title: e2e.bike
feeds.description: Cycling adventures across Britain and beyond. Bike touring inspiration from the website of UK cycling writer Rob Ainsley. Read about End-to-End rides (and other routes) in York, Yorkshire, Britain, and round the world. Enjoy lively travel writing, lots of photos and plenty of humour.

feeds.title: Cycleplan » Cycle Savvy
feeds.description: Articles feature the latest cycling news, cycling reviews, accessories, advice, safety tips, insurance, cycling routes, and how-tos. Cycleplan provides specialist cycling insurance for you & your bike for leisure, commuting, offroad, competitions, enduro, track, road racing & triathlons.

feeds.title: 100climbs
feeds.description: The 100 greatest cycling climbs blog by the book's author Simon Warren.

feeds.title: Total Women's Cycling
feeds.description: For Women who love to Ride. Promoting Women's Cycling in the UK and abroad, with latest News, Guides and Reviews for all levels of Cycling. The UKs most popular cycling website for women.

feeds.title: London Cyclist
feeds.description: London Cyclist was founded by Andreas. His two passions are cycling and blogging which if the two combined together and had a baby it would be this website. He has been cycling since he can remember, enjoys taking part in many cycling events in London and he cannot imagine life without his bike.

feeds.title: Cyclestore Blog
feeds.description: Articles, news and tips on bike, clothing, accessories, roads, brands and more. Covers all things on cycling for anyone that loves to ride. No matter the discipline we have advice, news & reviews for you.

feeds.title: Cyclist
feeds.description: The road bike site. The brand new place for all your road cycling news, reviews, events, tutorials, buying advice and tips.

feeds.title: Pusher Of Pedals
feeds.description: I started out cycling many, many years ago and just fell in love with the sport. Keen to spread the word about cycling and the good it can do for you, I started up my blog. Getting in kit, bikes, helmets, and even coffee to try out and spread the word whether it's worth your money or not. While I'm not the best cyclist in the world, nothing will stop my passion for being on two wheels and the freedom that it gives you.

feeds.title: A Man On A Bike
feeds.description: Hi, welcome to A Man On A Bike. The Life and Times of an Ageing MAMIL. My name is Paul Ashbury, and for the last 25+ years I have been riding a road bike.... so tips, ideas and random thoughts from somebody who should know better. This is a website for the passion of cycling related items, ideas and projects. It is a personal website, all about the cycling concepts that interest me.
